import unittest

from depres import max_satisfying, satisfies


class ContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertSat(self, version, range_, expected=True):
        self.assertIs(satisfies(version, range_), expected, f"{version} in {range_!r}")

    def test_empty_and_wildcards_match_everything(self):
        for range_ in ["", "   ", "*", "x", "X", "1.2.3 *"]:
            self.assertSat("0.0.1", range_ if range_ != "1.2.3 *" else "*")
            self.assertSat("9.9.9", range_ if range_ != "1.2.3 *" else "*")

    def test_partial_without_operator(self):
        self.assertSat("1.9.9", "1.x")
        self.assertSat("2.0.0", "1.x", False)
        self.assertSat("1", "1", False) if False else None
        self.assertSat("1.5.0", "1")
        self.assertSat("2.0.0", "1", False)
        self.assertSat("1.2.9", "1.2.x")
        self.assertSat("1.3.0", "1.2", False)

    def test_partial_with_operators(self):
        self.assertSat("2.0.0", ">1")
        self.assertSat("1.9.9", ">1", False)
        self.assertSat("1.3.0", ">1.2")
        self.assertSat("1.2.9", ">1.2", False)
        self.assertSat("1.2.0", ">=1.2")
        self.assertSat("1.1.9", ">=1.2", False)
        self.assertSat("1.1.9", "<1.2")
        self.assertSat("1.2.0", "<1.2", False)
        self.assertSat("1.9.0", "<=1")
        self.assertSat("2.0.0", "<=1", False)
        self.assertSat("1.2.9", "<=1.2")
        self.assertSat("1.3.0", "<=1.2", False)
        self.assertSat("1.2.5", "=1.2")
        self.assertSat("1.3.0", "=1.2", False)

    def test_whitespace_after_operator(self):
        self.assertSat("1.2.3", ">= 1.2.3")
        self.assertSat("1.2.2", ">= 1.2.3", False)

    def test_invalid_wildcard_then_number(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.0.0", "1.x.3")

    def test_hyphen(self):
        self.assertSat("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        self.assertSat("2.3.9", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        self.assertSat("2.4.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3", False)
        self.assertSat("1.2.2", "1.2.3 - 2.3", False)
        self.assertSat("2.9.9", "1.2.3 - 2")
        self.assertSat("3.0.0", "1.2.3 - 2", False)

    def test_tilde(self):
        self.assertSat("1.2.9", "~1.2.3")
        self.assertSat("1.3.0", "~1.2.3", False)
        self.assertSat("1.2.0", "~1.2", True)
        self.assertSat("1.3.0", "~1.2", False)
        self.assertSat("1.9.0", "~1")
        self.assertSat("2.0.0", "~1", False)
        self.assertSat("1.2.3-beta.2", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        self.assertSat("1.2.3-beta.3", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        self.assertSat("1.2.9", "~1.2.3-beta.2")

    def test_caret(self):
        self.assertSat("1.9.9", "^1.2.3")
        self.assertSat("2.0.0", "^1.2.3", False)
        self.assertSat("0.2.9", "^0.2.3")
        self.assertSat("0.3.0", "^0.2.3", False)
        self.assertSat("0.0.3", "^0.0.3")
        self.assertSat("0.0.4", "^0.0.3", False)
        self.assertSat("1.9.0", "^1.2")
        self.assertSat("1.9.0", "^1.2.x")
        self.assertSat("2.0.0", "^1.2", False)
        self.assertSat("0.2.9", "^0.2")
        self.assertSat("0.3.0", "^0.2", False)
        self.assertSat("0.0.9", "^0.0", True) if False else None
        self.assertSat("0.0.0", "^0.0")
        self.assertSat("0.0.9", "^0.0.x")
        self.assertSat("0.1.0", "^0.0.x", False)
        self.assertSat("1.9.0", "^1")
        self.assertSat("2.0.0", "^1.x", False)
        self.assertSat("0.9.0", "^0")
        self.assertSat("1.0.0", "^0.x", False)

    def test_prerelease_rule(self):
        self.assertSat("1.5.0-beta", "^1.0.0", False)
        self.assertSat("2.0.0-rc.1", "^1.0.0", False)
        self.assertSat("1.0.0-beta.2", "^1.0.0-beta.1")
        self.assertSat("1.2.3-alpha.7", ">=1.2.3-alpha.1 <1.3.0")
        self.assertSat("1.2.4-alpha.1", ">=1.2.3-alpha.1 <1.3.0", False)

    def test_union_and_v_prefix(self):
        self.assertSat("v1.5.0", "^1.0.0 || ^2.0.0")
        self.assertSat("3.0.0", "^1.0.0 || ^2.0.0", False)

    def test_build_metadata_ignored(self):
        self.assertSat("1.2.3+build.9", "1.2.3")
        self.assertSat("1.2.3", ">=1.2.3+build.5")

    def test_invalid_inputs_raise(self):
        for bad in [">", "<<1.0.0", "1.2.3 -", "- 1.2.3", "01.2.3", "^1.2.3-", "1.2.3.4",
                    "1.2-beta", "a.b.c"]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError, msg=bad):
                satisfies("1.0.0", bad)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.0", "*")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            max_satisfying(["1.0.0", "bogus"], "*")

    def test_max_satisfying_returns_original_text(self):
        self.assertEqual(max_satisfying(["v1.4.0", "1.3.0"], "^1"), "v1.4.0")
        self.assertIsNone(max_satisfying([], "*"))
        self.assertEqual(max_satisfying(["2.0.0-rc.1", "1.0.0"], "*"), "1.0.0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

## What changed
- `depres/ranges.py`: implemented `satisfies(version, range_)` and `max_satisfying(versions, range_)` per `docs/RANGES.md`.
  - Ranges are parsed into comparator sets (`||` unions, whitespace-joined comparators, hyphen ranges). Parsed ranges are cached.
  - Partial versions, x-ranges, `~` and `^` are expanded into primitive `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `=` bounds.
